parameters.command: =timeout 600 docker exec schemathesis sh -c 'schemathesis run "{{ $json.openApiUrl }}" -u "{{ $json.baseUrl }}" -c all -n 10 -w 4 --report junit --report-junit-path=/results/$(basename "{{ $json.schemathesisOut }}") --coverage-no-report --no-color > /tmp/st.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/st.log'

=timeout 400 docker exec cats sh -c 'cats -c "{{ $json.openApiUrl }}" -s "{{ $json.baseUrl }}" -k --stopAfterTimeInSec=240 -o /results/cats_report_{{ $json.runId }} --reportFormat=JUNIT > /tmp/cats.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/cats.log'
